Thanks for the Memories...
It's been 13 years, over a thousand backpackers, many more thousands of avocados, mangos,and lychee picked and packed, hundreds of thousands of macadamia trees planted, and many others grafted, pruned and irrigated.
We set out to create a hostel where backpackers enjoyed their time on farms and created lifelong friends and memories - job done!
If you missed out on the Childers Ecolodge experience, apply to Farmgate Backpackers in Childers - they'll look after you.
